thread:
Alex: Hey team — opened PR #6123 for the tracehook changes (adds model_id/span attrs + heatmap metric, plus a tiny lint fix). CI passed unit tests but metrics-e2e hit a timeout once. Need one more code review and a merge window today if possible. Can someone take a look?
Sara: On my list, will skim in ~30m. left a note about the histogram bucket boundaries — looks like we should coarsen one bucket.
Morgan: I can handle merge timing. Requested a 2pm UTC canary slot from infra, waiting on confirmation. @deploy-bot can you annotate the PR with the canary tag when slot is confirmed?
deploy-bot: Canary slot request received for PR #6123, pending infra approval. If approved, tag `canary/2pm-UTC` will be added.
Priya: Quick review done — addressed the bucket comment and updated the test for the new span attr. Approved in GH after Alex pushed the follow-up commit.
James: Quick question: are any metric names changing that dashboards rely on? We should avoid surprise renames before the canary.
Alex: Good call — one minor rename: `metrics.foo_latency` -> `metrics.request_latency` to be more consistent. I added a note in the PR description and a short migration note for dashboards. I can open a follow-up PR to update dashboards if you want, James.
Sara: Approved from my side as well. @Morgan please merge after canary passes.
Morgan: Will monitor the canary. If the metrics-e2e flakes again, re-run with `/ci retry` (or I can re-trigger manually). Planning to merge on green and then tag the deploy.
Alex: Thanks y'all :thumbsup: If anyone wants the dashboard PR, @James I can assign it to you or open it for you to take a pass.
James: Please assign to me, I'll reconcile dashboards post-canary.
Priya: Nice work — looks safe to me.
Morgan: Infra confirmed the 2pm UTC slot, deploy-bot just added `canary/2pm-UTC`. Merging after green unless any objections.
Alex: No objections. Merging window acknowledged.
deploy-bot: Tag `canary/2pm-UTC` added to PR #6123. Canary scheduled.
Alex: Merged after canary success — thanks everyone. Follow-up dashboard PR opened: #6130.
